channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Ivanti
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Ivanti, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Allows Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
item.description:
Ivanti Endpoint Manager: RCE · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Ivanti Endpoint Manager. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available

item.title: Patch (update): Ivanti Connect Secure: 2 flaws exploited together
item.description:
Ivanti Connect Secure: Authentication bypass · exploit chain · exploited · fix: 25.1.1.3, 22.8R2.6 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update Ivanti Connect Secure to 25.1.1.3 or 22.8R2.6 or later.

Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527
